title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Dustin Tharp"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  survey = "acs5",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Median household income (USD)",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income Across Texas Counties",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
